messages:
Elaine (mktg-ops): Heads up — noticed increase in unassigned leads when HS enrichment hits >10s. Some are not reaching Salesforce for handoff. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Marcus (growth): Yeah saw spike this morning, ~30 leads. looks like wf filter timing out after enrichment job
Priya (sales-eng): Is this around the new intent-score enrichment we rolled last week? Could be blocking before assignment
Olivia (sales-ops): Confirmed. HS shows "workflow paused" for leads with enrichment=waiting. SF connector only pulls on "assigned owner" event so they fall through
Tom (revops): Quick thought: split routing into "fastlane" (no enrichment wait, assign immediately for SDR) and "quality-lane" (enrich then route to AE). Will reduce SLA backpressure
Elaine (mktg-ops): I like that. Proposed param: if intent_score >= 0.8 OR company_size >= 50 -> fastlane. Others -> quality-lane with 5m max enrichment window
Marcus (growth): Also add heartbeat to SF for "temp-owner:queue" so sales sees it and can triage. Otherwise leads look unassigned
Priya (sales-eng): Example HubSpot workflow snippet:
```
IF enrichment_status == pending AND intent_score < 0.8
  WAIT 5 minutes
  IF enrichment_status == done -> SET owner: round_robin
  ELSE -> SET owner: temp-queue; ADD note: "enrichment delayed"
```
Olivia (sales-ops): Agree. For round-robin fix we should persist the "claimed_by" token in HS properties so repeated assignment doesn't bounce
Tom (revops): Can we deploy quick patch to the connector: on HS contact property change -> upsert SF lead with owner=temp-queue and create task for SDR to triage. If no triage in 15m -> escalate to rotation
Elaine (mktg-ops): Action items:
- Tom -> patch connector for heartbeat & temp-owner (ETA EOD)
- Priya -> update HS workflow JSON + test (ETA tomorrow AM)
- Marcus -> add metric to dashboard: % leads unassigned >10m
- Olivia -> doc workaround for SDRs (pinning instructions)
deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy to staging after PR approval :rocket:
Elaine (mktg-ops): Thanks team — syncing with sales leadership at 2pm, will confirm approach then. :thumbsup:
